# Performance files

[← Back to the index](../quickstart.md)

| File | Size | Use it for |
|---|--:|---|
| [large.md](large.md) | ~200KB | Everyday "big document": scrolling, resizing, preview toggles |
| [huge.md](huge.md) | ~2MB | Stress test: open time, typing in the middle, preview rendering |

Both are generated by `generate.py` with a fixed seed, so numbers are comparable between builds.
Regenerate them with:

```sh
python3 testdata/perf/generate.py
```

## With the HUD (F12)

1. Scroll fast: `p99` should stay well under 16.7ms, which is 60 fps, and `fps` shows the rate you're
   really drawing at.
2. Drag the window edge mid-document: the top line should stay put.
3. If anything stutters, press **F11** straight away. It saves the last 1,024 frames to a file, with
   what each one spent its time on.

## Benchmark

```sh
tmd --bench testdata/perf/large.md
tmd --bench testdata/perf/huge.md
```

The benchmark prints a Markdown table with percentiles per scenario, and exits 1 if any scenario misses
the 60 fps budget. `perf/review.py` runs it several times and compares against a saved baseline.
